read.thesis: Aluminium price-led quarter with adj. EBITDA up $276M to $546M; 2026 guidance points to San Ciprian restart adding tons while alumina margins compress to near breakeven.

capex.peers_comment: Management said anticipated smelting capacity growth in Indonesia; China near its 45 million ton cap.
capex.quote: Our capital expenditure estimate is $750 million, with $675 million in sustaining and $75 million in return-seeking.

triggers.label: San Ciprian 65% restart
triggers.quote: approximately 65% of the capacity in operation at the end of 2025

triggers.label: Aluminium inventories lowest in 15 years
triggers.quote: inventories measured in days of consumption fell to their lowest year-end level in at least fifteen years

triggers.label: Iceland/Mozambique cuts ~550kt
triggers.quote: recently announced disruptions in Iceland and Mozambique could remove over 550,000 metric tons from the market in 2026

triggers.label: Alumina pressure on ~60% of China refineries
triggers.quote: current pricing levels continue to put pressure on about 60% of China refineries

triggers.label: Guinea bauxite supply rising
triggers.quote: supplies increasing in Guinea as restarted capacity from suspended licenses comes to market

red_flags.label: Q4 EBITDA boosted by one-off CO2 credits
red_flags.quote: CO2 compensation credits in Norway and Spain provided one-time fourth-quarter EBITDA benefits

evasions.quote: I think it's very hard to call with all the geopolitical changes that are going on around the world
Going to hold on that until we close the deal.
